transmissions.cw: CQ CQ CQ DE KD9DIH KD9DIH K
transmissions.translation: Calling CQ from KD9DIH. Any station may answer.

transmissions.cw: KD9DIH DE W8ABC W8ABC K
transmissions.translation: KD9DIH, this is W8ABC. Go ahead.

transmissions.cw: W8ABC DE KD9DIH = GE TNX FER CALL = UR RST 579 579 = QTH WI WI = HW CPY? W8ABC DE KD9DIH <KN>
transmissions.translation: Good evening. Thanks for the call. Your RST is 579. My QTH is Wisconsin. How are you copying me? W8ABC, back to you only.

transmissions.cw: KD9DIH DE W8ABC = GE OM TNX RPRT = UR RST 589 589 = QTH OH OH = NAME BOB BOB = KD9DIH DE W8ABC <KN>
transmissions.translation: Good evening. Thanks for the report. Your RST is 589. My QTH is Ohio. My name is Bob. Back to you.

transmissions.cw: W8ABC DE KD9DIH = R FB BOB TNX = 73 ES HPE CUAGN = W8ABC DE KD9DIH <KN>
transmissions.translation: Roger, fine business Bob, thanks. Best regards and hope to see you again. Back to you.

transmissions.cw: KD9DIH DE W8ABC = TU FER QSO = 73 JIM = KD9DIH DE W8ABC <SK>
transmissions.translation: Thank you for the QSO. Best regards, Jim. End of contact.

transmissions.cw: CQ CQ CQ DE KD9DIH KD9DIH K
transmissions.translation: General CQ.

transmissions.cw: KD9DIH DE K4RLC K
transmissions.translation: K4RLC answering you.

transmissions.cw: K4RLC DE KD9DIH = GM TNX CALL = UR RST 599 599 = NAME JIM = QTH WI = RIG FT710 PWR 50W = ANT EFHW = HW? K4RLC DE KD9DIH <KN>
transmissions.translation: Good morning. Thanks for the call. You are 599. Name is Jim, QTH Wisconsin. Rig is an FT-710, running 50 watts, antenna is an end-fed half-wave. How copy?

transmissions.cw: KD9DIH DE K4RLC = R FB JIM = UR 589 589 = NAME TOM = QTH TN = RIG K3 PWR 100W = ANT DIPOLE UP 40 FT = FB SIG = KD9DIH DE K4RLC <KN>
transmissions.translation: Roger, fine business Jim. You are 589. Name Tom, QTH Tennessee. Rig is a K3 at 100 watts. Antenna is a dipole 40 feet up. Fine signal.

transmissions.cw: K4RLC DE KD9DIH = FB TOM TNX INFO = NICE SIG HR = TNX QSO 73 K4RLC DE KD9DIH <SK>
transmissions.translation: Fine business Tom, thanks for the information. Nice signal here. Thanks for the QSO and 73. End contact.

transmissions.cw: CQ CQ CQ DE KD9DIH KD9DIH K
transmissions.translation: Calling CQ.

transmissions.cw: KD9DIH DE W3MTR W3MTR K
transmissions.translation: W3MTR answering.

transmissions.cw: W3MTR DE KD9DIH = TNX CALL = UR RST 449 449 = SIG QSB = NAME JIM = QTH WI = HW? W3MTR DE KD9DIH <KN>
transmissions.translation: Thanks for the call. You are 449. Your signal is fading. Name Jim, QTH Wisconsin. How copy?

transmissions.cw: KD9DIH DE W3MTR = R R = UR 559 559 = SRI QSB HR ALSO = NAME ? NAME ? PSE AGN <BK>
transmissions.translation: Roger. You are 559. Sorry, there is fading here too. Please repeat your name. Break.

transmissions.cw: <BK> NAME JIM JIM = JIM <BK>
transmissions.translation: Break. Name is Jim, Jim. Break.

transmissions.cw: <BK> R R JIM TNX = NAME HR DAVE DAVE = QTH PA = <BK>
transmissions.translation: Roger, got it, Jim. Thanks. My name is Dave, QTH Pennsylvania. Break.

transmissions.cw: <BK> R DAVE TNX = QSB BAD NW = TNX QSO 73 ES GUD DX = W3MTR DE KD9DIH <SK>
transmissions.translation: Roger Dave, thanks. Fading is bad now. Thanks for the QSO, 73, and good DX. End contact.

transmissions.cw: CQ CQ CQ DE KD9DIH KD9DIH K
transmissions.translation: Calling CQ.

transmissions.cw: KD9DIH DE N2XYZ N2XYZ K
transmissions.translation: N2XYZ responds.

transmissions.cw: N2XYZ DE KD9DIH = GE TNX CALL = PSE QRS QRS = NEW CW OP HR = N2XYZ DE KD9DIH <KN>
transmissions.translation: Good evening, thanks for the call. Please send slower. I am a new CW operator here. Back to you.

transmissions.cw: KD9DIH DE N2XYZ = R R QRS = NO PROB OM = UR RST 579 = NAME MIKE = QTH NY = HW? KD9DIH DE N2XYZ <KN>
transmissions.translation: Roger, slowing down. No problem. You are 579. Name Mike, QTH New York. How copy?

transmissions.cw: N2XYZ DE KD9DIH = R FB MIKE = UR RST 589 = TNX FER QRS = NAME JIM QTH WI = N2XYZ DE KD9DIH <KN>
transmissions.translation: Roger, fine business Mike. You are 589. Thanks for slowing down. Name Jim, QTH Wisconsin.

transmissions.cw: KD9DIH DE N2XYZ = FB JIM = KEEP CW = CUAGN 73 KD9DIH DE N2XYZ <SK>
transmissions.translation: Fine business Jim. Keep at CW. See you again, 73. End contact.

transmissions.cw: CQ CQ DX DE DL7ABC DL7ABC K
transmissions.translation: DL7ABC in Germany is calling CQ DX.

transmissions.cw: DL7ABC DE KD9DIH KD9DIH K
transmissions.translation: KD9DIH answering.

transmissions.cw: KD9DIH DE DL7ABC = GM UR 559 559 = QTH BERLIN = OP HANS = KD9DIH DE DL7ABC <KN>
transmissions.translation: Good morning. You are 559. QTH Berlin. Operator Hans. Back to you.

transmissions.cw: DL7ABC DE KD9DIH = R TNX HANS = UR 579 579 = QTH WI = OP JIM = TNX QSO 73 DL7ABC DE KD9DIH <KN>
transmissions.translation: Roger, thanks Hans. You are 579. QTH Wisconsin. Operator Jim. Thanks for the QSO, 73.

transmissions.cw: KD9DIH DE DL7ABC = TU 73 <SK>
transmissions.translation: Thank you, 73, end contact.

transmissions.cw: W1MOR DE KD9DIH = GE = UR RST 559 = QRN HR = NAME JIM = QTH WI = HW? W1MOR DE KD9DIH <KN>
transmissions.translation: Good evening. You are 559. I have static here. Name Jim, QTH Wisconsin. How copy?

transmissions.cw: KD9DIH DE W1MOR = R JIM = UR 579 = NAME AL = QTH VT = WX COLD TEMP 35F = KD9DIH DE W1MOR <KN>
transmissions.translation: Roger Jim. You are 579. Name Al, QTH Vermont. Weather is cold, temperature 35 degrees Fahrenheit.

transmissions.cw: W1MOR DE KD9DIH = SRI QRN = QTH? QTH? PSE AGN <BK>
transmissions.translation: Sorry, static interference. Please repeat your QTH. Break.

transmissions.cw: <BK> QTH VT VT = VERMONT <BK>
transmissions.translation: QTH Vermont, Vermont. Break.

transmissions.cw: <BK> R R VT = TNX AL = WX HR CLR ES 50F = TNX QSO 73 W1MOR DE KD9DIH <SK>
transmissions.translation: Roger, Vermont copied. Thanks Al. Weather here is clear and 50 degrees Fahrenheit. Thanks for the QSO, 73, end contact.

transmissions.cw: CQ CQ CQ DE KD9DIH/QRP KD9DIH/QRP K
transmissions.translation: KD9DIH calling CQ while operating QRP.

transmissions.cw: KD9DIH/QRP DE K8CW K
transmissions.translation: K8CW answers.

transmissions.cw: K8CW DE KD9DIH/QRP = TNX CALL = UR 579 = PWR HR 5W 5W = RIG FT710 = ANT DIPOLE = HW? K8CW DE KD9DIH/QRP <KN>
transmissions.translation: Thanks for the call. You are 579. I am running 5 watts, using an FT-710 and dipole. How copy?

transmissions.cw: KD9DIH/QRP DE K8CW = FB JIM = UR 559 559 = GUD SIG FER 5W = PWR HR 100W = ANT YAGI = KD9DIH/QRP DE K8CW <KN>
transmissions.translation: Fine business Jim. You are 559. Good signal for 5 watts. I am running 100 watts into a Yagi.

transmissions.cw: K8CW DE KD9DIH/QRP = R TNX FB RPRT = 73 ES GUD DX = K8CW DE KD9DIH/QRP <SK>
transmissions.translation: Roger, thanks for the good report. 73 and good DX. End contact.

transmissions.cw: W8ABC DE KD9DIH = QRM BAD HR = PSE QSY UP 2 = W8ABC DE KD9DIH <KN>
transmissions.translation: W8ABC, interference is bad here. Please move up 2 kilohertz. Back to you.

transmissions.cw: KD9DIH DE W8ABC = R QSY UP 2 = CU THERE <SK>
transmissions.translation: Roger. Moving up 2 kilohertz. See you there. End contact.

transmissions.cw: QRZ? QRZ? DE DL7ABC K
transmissions.translation: Who is calling me? This is DL7ABC. Go ahead.

transmissions.cw: KD9DIH KD9DIH
transmissions.translation: KD9DIH calls twice.

transmissions.cw: KD9DIH 599 = QSL? <KN>
transmissions.translation: KD9DIH, you are 599. Did you copy? Back to you only.

transmissions.cw: CQ CQ DE K8CW/P K8CW/P K
transmissions.translation: K8CW is calling CQ while operating portable.

transmissions.cw: KD9DIH DE K8CW/P = UR 579 = PWR 10W = ANT WIRE = WX FB = KD9DIH DE K8CW/P <KN>
transmissions.translation: KD9DIH, you are 579. I am running 10 watts to a wire antenna. The weather is fine. Back to you.

transmissions.cw: CQ TEST DE W8ABC W8ABC K
transmissions.translation: W8ABC is calling for contest contacts.

transmissions.cw: W8ABC DE KD9DIH
transmissions.translation: KD9DIH answers W8ABC.

transmissions.cw: KD9DIH 5NN WI
transmissions.translation: KD9DIH, your report is 599 and my location is Wisconsin.

transmissions.cw: R 5NN WI TU
transmissions.translation: Roger, your report is 599 and my location is Wisconsin. Thank you.
